WHY THESE VALUES. A freshly created bunny `sites` pull zone defaults to
CacheControlMaxAgeOverride=2592000 — thirty days — on EVERYTHING, including
index.html and sw.js. That would pin a user to a month-old app shell and
prevent the service worker from ever discovering an update. Measured live on
The floor is short ZONE-WIDE rather than long-with-exceptions, deliberately:
if a per-path rule ever fails to match, the failure mode is 'revalidates too
often' (a bandwidth cost) instead of 'serves a stale wallet' (a correctness
Hashed assets under /assets/ are content-addressed and COULD be cached for a
year. They are not, because no working per-path cache lever was found in this
CLI/API surface: an ActionType 9 (SetResponseHeader) edge rule was accepted
but stored its ActionParameter1/2 as empty strings and degraded assets to
`no-cache, no-store`; ActionType 7 dropped its parameter the same way. The
rule was deleted. Revisit if bunny exposes this properly.
